name: Belt of Stitches
body:
Price 13,000 gp; Aura faint conjuration; CL 5; Weight 1 lb.

DESCRIPTION

This old leather belt is held together by hundreds of stitches, as though it has been mended over and over again. While wearing this belt you may heal yourself as a swift action as though you cast cure moderate wounds three times per day.

CONSTRUCTION REQUIREMENTS

Cost 6,500 gp; Feats Craft Wondrous Item, cure moderate wounds
